     1→<!DOCTYPE html>
     2→<html lang="en">
     3→<head>
     4→<meta charset="UTF-8">
     5→<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
     6→<title>Star FM 102.9 | For The Brighter Side Of You</title>
     7→<meta name="description" content="Star FM 102.9 MHz — Klerksdorp's community radio station. Live streaming 24/7 across the Southern District of North West Province.">
     8→<meta name="theme-color" content="#050a03">
     9→<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    10→<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@700;800&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&family=Syne+Mono&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    11→<style>
    12→
    13→/* ── TOKENS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    14→:root {
    15→  --bg:      #050a03;
    16→  --bg2:     #091209;
    17→  --panel:   #0d1a0d;
    18→  --panel2:  #112011;
    19→  --border:  rgba(46,204,64,0.12);
    20→  --green:   #2ecc40;
    21→  --green2:  #27ae36;
    22→  --lime:    #a8f0b0;
    23→  --white:   #edf7ee;
    24→  --muted:   rgba(168,240,176,0.6);
    25→  --red:     #ff4444;
    26→  --r: 16px;
    27→  --r2: 24px;
    28→  --r3: 32px;
    29→}
    30→
    31→/* ── RESET ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    32→*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    33→html { scroll-behavior: smooth; -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }
    34→body {
    35→  background: var(--bg);
    36→  color: var(--white);
    37→  font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif;
    38→  font-weight: 300;
    39→  overflow-x: hidden;
    40→  line-height: 1.6;
    41→  /* subtle green atmosphere */
    42→  background-image:
    43→    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 10% 20%, rgba(46,204,64,0.06) 0%, transparent 70%),
    44→    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 90% 80%, rgba(46,204,64,0.04) 0%, transparent 70%);
    45→}
    46→img { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
    47→a { color: inherit; }
    48→
    49→/* ── TYPOGRAPHY ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    50→.syne { font-family: "Syne", sans-serif; }
    51→.mono { font-family: "Syne Mono", monospace; }
    52→
    53→/* ── UTILITY ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    54→.sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); }
    55→
    56→/* ── CUSTOM CURSOR (desktop only) ───────────────────────────────── */
    57→@media (pointer: fine) {
    58→  body { cursor: none; }
    59→  #cur, #cur-r {
    60→    position: fixed; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999; top: 0; left: 0;
    61→  }
    62→  #cur { width: 10px; height: 10px; background: var(--green); transform: translate(-50%,-50%); }
    63→  #cur-r {
    64→    width: 32px; height: 32px;
    65→    border: 1.5px solid rgba(46,204,64,0.5);
    66→    transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
    67→    transition: transform 0.08s, width 0.3s, height 0.3s, opacity 0.3s;
    68→  }
    69→}
    70→
    71→/* ── NOISE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    72→body::after {
    73→  content: "";
    74→  position: fixed; inset: 0;
    75→  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='0.03'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
    76→  pointer-events: none; z-index: 9990; opacity: 0.5;
    77→}
    78→
    79→/* ── NAV ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    80→#nav {
    81→  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 200;
    82→  padding: 0 20px;
    83→  height: 64px;
    84→  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    85→  transition: background 0.4s, border-color 0.4s, box-shadow 0.4s;
    86→  border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    87→}
    88→#nav.stuck {
    89→  background: rgba(5,10,3,0.97);
    90→  border-color: var(--border);
    91→  box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    92→  backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
    93→}
    94→.nav-brand {
    95→  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    96→  text-decoration: none; flex-shrink: 0;
    97→}
    98→.nav-logo-img {
    99→  width: 40px; height: 40px;
   100→  border-radius: 50%;
   101→  background: #fff;
   102→  padding: 2px;
   103→  object-fit: contain;
   104→  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(46,204,64,0.35), 0 0 16px rgba(46,204,64,0.2);
   105→}
   106→.nav-wordmark { line-height: 1; }
   107→.nav-wordmark strong {
   108→  display: block;
   109→  font-family: "Syne", sans-serif;
   110→  font-weight: 800;
   111→  font-size: 1.1rem;
   112→  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
   113→  color: var(--white);
   114→}
   115→.nav-wordmark strong span { color: var(--green); }
   116→.nav-wordmark small {
   117→  display: block;
   118→  font-size: 0.5rem;
   119→  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
   120→  text-transform: uppercase;
   121→  color: var(--muted);
   122→  margin-top: 1px;
   123→}
   124→.nav-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
   125→.nav-links {
   126→  display: none;
   127→  list-style: none;
   128→  gap: 28px;
   129→  align-items: center;
   130→}
   131→.nav-links a {
   132→  font-size: 0.78rem;
   133→  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
   134→  text-transform: uppercase;
   135→  color: var(--muted);
   136→  text-decoration: none;
   137→  transition: color 0.2s;
   138→}
   139→.nav-links a:hover { color: var(--green); }
   140→.btn-live {
   141→  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
   142→  background: rgba(255,68,68,0.1);
   143→  border: 1px solid rgba(255,68,68,0.3);
   144→  border-radius: 100px;
   145→  padding: 8px 16px;
   146→  font-size: 0.72rem;
   147→  font-weight: 500;
   148→  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
   149→  text-transform: uppercase;
   150→  color: var(--red);
   151→  text-decoration: none;
   152→  transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
   153→  white-space: nowrap;
   154→}
   155→.btn-live:hover { background: rgba(255,68,68,0.2); transform: scale(1.03); }
   156→.live-dot {
   157→  width: 7px; height: 7px;
   158→  background: var(--red);
   159→  border-radius: 50%;
   160→  animation: blink 1.2s infinite;
   161→  flex-shrink: 0;
   162→}
   163→@keyframes blink { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0.15} }
   164→
   165→/* hamburger */
   166→.ham {
   167→  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px;
   168→  cursor: pointer; padding: 6px; background: none; border: none;
   169→}
   170→.ham span {
   171→  display: block; width: 22px; height: 1.5px;
   172→  background: var(--white); border-radius: 2px;
   173→  transition: all 0.3s;
   174→}
   175→.ham.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(6.5px) rotate(45deg); }
   176→.ham.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; transform: scaleX(0); }
   177→.ham.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-6.5px) rotate(-45deg); }
   178→
   179→/* ── MOBILE DRAWER ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
   180→#drawer {
   181→  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 190;
   182→  background: rgba(5,10,3,0.98);
   183→  backdrop-filter: blur(32px);
   184→  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
   185→  align-items: center; justify-content: center;
   186→  gap: 8px;
   187→  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
   188→  transition: opacity 0.3s;
   189→}
   190→#drawer.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; }
   191→#drawer a {
   192→  font-family: "Syne", sans-serif;
   193→  font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 8vw, 3rem);
   194→  font-weight: 800;
   195→  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
   196→  color: var(--white);
   197→  text-decoration: none;
   198→  padding: 8px 24px;
   199→  transition: color 0.2s;
   200→}
   201→#drawer a:hover { color: var(--green); }
   202→#drawer .d-live {
   203→  margin-top: 24px;
   204→  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
   205→  background: rgba(255,68,68,0.12);
   206→  border: 1px solid rgba(255,68,68,0.3);
   207→  border-radius: 100px;
   208→  padding: 14px 28px;
   209→  font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif;
   210→  font-size: 0.9rem;
   211→  font-weight: 500;
   212→  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
   213→  text-transform: uppercase;
   214→  color: var(--red);
   215→}
   216→
   217→/* ── LANG SWITCHER ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
   218→.lang-sw {
   219→  display: flex; gap: 2px;
   220→  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
   221→  border: 1px solid var(--border);
   222→  border-radius: 100px;
   223→  padding: 3px;
   224→}
   225→.lang-sw button {
   226→  background: none; border: none;
   227→  padding: 5px 10px;
   228→  border-radius: 100px;
   229→  font-family: "Syne", sans-serif;
   230→  font-size: 0.65rem;
   231→  font-weight: 700;
   232→  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
   233→  text-transform: uppercase;
   234→  color: var(--muted);
   235→  cursor: pointer;
   236→  transition: all 0.2s;
   237→  white-space: nowrap;
   238→}
   239→.lang-sw button.on {
   240→  background: var(--green);
   241→  color: #050a03;
   242→}
   243→
   244→/* ── HERO ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
   245→#hero {
   246→  min-height: 100svh;
   247→  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
   248→  align-items: center; justify-content: center;
   249→  padding: 88px 20px 64px;
   250→  text-align: center;
   251→  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
   252→}
   253→.hero-glow {
   254→  position: absolute;
   255→  width: min(700px, 120vw); height: min(700px, 120vw);
   256→  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(46,204,64,0.15) 0%, transparent 65%);
   257→  top: 50%; left: 50%;
   258→  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
   259→  pointer-events: none;
   260→  animation: glow 5s ease-in-out infinite;
   261→}
   262→@keyframes glow { 0%,100%{opacity:.6;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)} 50%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.12)} }
   263→.hero-wave {
   264→  position: absolute; inset: 0;
   265→  opacity: 0.05; pointer-events: none;
   266→  display: flex; align-items: center;
   267→}
   268→.hero-wave svg { width: 100%; }
   269→.hero-badge {
   270→  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
   271→  background: rgba(46,204,64,0.08);
   272→  border: 1px solid rgba(46,204,64,0.2);
   273→  border-radius: 100px;
   274→  padding: 8px 18px;
   275→  font-size: 0.68rem;
   276→  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
   277→  text-transform: uppercase;
   278→  color: var(--green);
   279→  margin-bottom: 28px;
   280→  animation: up 0.8s both;
   281→}
   282→h1 {
   283→  font-family: "Syne", sans-serif;
   284→  font-weight: 800;
   285→  font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 11vw, 7rem);
   286→  line-height: 0.92;
   287→  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
   288→  margin-bottom: 24px;
   289→  animation: up 0.8s 0.08s both;
   290→}
   291→h1 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--green); display: block; }
   292→.hero-sub {
   293→  max-width: 520px;
   294→  font-size: clamp(0.92rem, 2.5vw, 1.05rem);
   295→  line-height: 1.75;
   296→  color: var(--muted);
   297→  margin: 0 auto 36px;
   298→  animation: up 0.8s 0.16s both;
   299→}
   300→.hero-sub strong { color: var(--lime); font-weight: 500; }
   301→.hero-ctas {
   302→  display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap;
   303→  justify-content: center;
   304→  margin-bottom: 56px;
   305→  animation: up 0.8s 0.24s both;
   306→}
   307→.btn-p {
   308→  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
   309→  background: var(--green); color: #050a03;
   310→  border: none; border-radius: 100px;
   311→  padding: 15px 28px;
   312→  font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif;
   313→  font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem;
   314→  text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer;
   315→  transition: all 0.25s;
   316→  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
   317→}
   318→.btn-p:hover { background: var(--lime); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(46,204,64,0.3); }
   319→.btn-g {
   320→  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
   321→  background: transparent; color: var(--white);
   322→  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
   323→  border-radius: 100px;
   324→  padding: 15px 28px;
   325→  font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif;
   326→  font-weight: 400; font-size: 0.9rem;
   327→  text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer;
   328→  transition: all 0.25s;
   329→  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
   330→}
   331→.btn-g:hover { border-color: rgba(46,204,64,0.4); background: rgba(46,204,64,0.06); transform: translateY(-2px); }
   332→
   333→/* PLAYER CARD */
   334→.player-card {
   335→  width: 100%; max-width: 600px;
   336→  background: var(--panel);
   337→  border: 1px solid var(--border);
   338→  border-radius: var(--r2);
   339→  padding: 20px;
   340→  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
   341→  animation: up 0.8s 0.32s both;
   342→}
   343→.player-card::before {
   344→  content: "";
   345→  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px;
   346→  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--green), transparent);
   347→}
   348→.player-top {
   349→  display: flex; align-items: center;
   350→  justify-content: space-between;
   351→  margin-bottom: 16px;
   352→}
   353→.player-label {
   354→  font-family: "Syne Mono", monospace;
   355→  font-size: 0.72rem;
   356→  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
   357→  text-transform: uppercase;
   358→  color: var(--muted);
   359→}
   360→.on-air {
   361→  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
   362→  background: rgba(255,68,68,0.12);
   363→  border: 1px solid rgba(255,68,68,0.25);
   364→  border-radius: 100px;
   365→  padding: 5px 12px;
   366→  font-size: 0.68rem;
   367→  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
   368→  text-transform: uppercase;
   369→  color: var(--red);
   370→  font-weight: 500;
   371→}
   372→.player-embed { border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: #000; }
   373→.player-embed iframe { width: 100%; height: 76px; border: none; display: block; }
   374→.player-bottom {
   375→  display: flex; align-items: center;
   376→  justify-content: space-between;
   377→  margin-top: 14px;
   378→}
   379→.np { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--muted); }
   380→.np strong { color: var(--white); font-weight: 500; }
   381→.eq { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 3px; height: 20px; }
   382→.eq span {
   383→  width: 3px; background: var(--green); border-radius: 2px;
   384→  animation: eq 1s infinite;
   385→}
   386→.eq span:nth-child(1){animation-delay:0s}
   387→.eq span:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s}
   388→.eq span:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.3s}
   389→.eq span:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.1s}
   390→.eq span:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.25s}
   391→@keyframes eq { 0%,100%{height:3px} 50%{height:18px} }
   392→@keyframes up { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }
   393→
   394→/* ── TICKER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
   395→.ticker-wrap {
   396→  background: var(--green);
   397→  overflow: hidden; padding: 13px 0;
   398→}
   399→.ticker { display: flex; width: max-content; animation: tick 35s linear infinite; }
   400→.ticker-wrap:hover .ticker { animation-play-state: paused; }
   401→@keyframes tick { from{transform:translateX(0)} to{transform:translateX(-50%)} }
   402→.ti {
   403→  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px;
   404→  padding: 0 28px;
   405→  font-family: "Syne", sans-serif;
   406→  font-size: 0.75rem;
   407→  font-weight: 700;
   408→  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
   409→  text-transform: uppercase;
   410→  color: #050a03;
   411→  white-space: nowrap;
   412→}
   413→.ti::after {
   414→  content: "";
   415→  width: 4px; height: 4px;
   416→  background: rgba(5,10,3,0.35);
   417→  border-radius: 50%;
   418→  flex-shrink: 0;
   419→}
   420→
   421→/* ── SECTIONS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
   422→section { padding: 80px 20px; }
   423→.sec-label {
   424→  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
   425→  font-family: "Syne Mono", monospace;
   426→  font-size: 0.68rem;
   427→  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
   428→  text-transform: uppercase;
   429→  color: var(--green);
   430→  margin-bottom: 14px;
   431→}
   432→.sec-label::before {
   433→  content: "";
   434→  width: 28px; height: 2px;
   435→  background: var(--green);
   436→  border-radius: 2px;
   437→  flex-shrink: 0;
   438→}
   439→.sec-title {
   440→  font-family: "Syne", sans-serif;
   441→  font-weight: 800;
   442→  font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 5.5vw, 3.4rem);
   443→  line-height: 1.05;
   444→  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
   445→  margin-bottom: 16px;
   446→}
   447→.sec-body {
   448→  font-size: clamp(0.88rem, 2vw, 1rem);
   449→  line-height: 1.8;
   450→  color: var(--muted);
   451→  max-width: 540px;
   452→}
   453→
   454→/* ── IMPACT ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
   455→#impact { background: var(--bg2); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
   456→.impact-grid {
   457→  display: grid;
   458→  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
   459→  gap: 1px;
   460→  background: var(--border);
   461→  border: 1px solid var(--border);
   462→  border-radius: var(--r2);
   463→  overflow: hidden;
   464→  margin-top: 48px;
   465→}
   466→.impact-cell {
   467→  background: var(--panel);
   468→  padding: 32px 24px;
   469→  transition: background 0.3s;
   470→}
   471→.impact-cell:hover { background: var(--panel2); }
   472→.impact-num {
   473→  font-family: "Syne", sans-serif;
   474→  font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 6vw, 3.5rem);
   475→  font-weight: 800;
   476→  color: var(--green);
   477→  line-height: 1;
   478→  margin-bottom: 8px;
   479→}
   480→.impact-lbl { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.5; }
   481→
   482→/* ── SHOWS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
   483→#shows { background: var(--bg); }
   484→.shows-wrap {
   485→  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
   486→  gap: 24px;
   487→  margin-top: 48px;
   488→}
   489→.show-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
   490→.show-row {
   491→  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
   492→  padding: 14px 16px;
   493→  border-radius: var(--r);
   494→  cursor: pointer;
   495→  border: 1px solid transparent;
   496→  transition: all 0.25s;
   497→  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
   498→}
   499→.show-row:hover, .show-row.on {
   500→  background: var(--panel);
   501→  border-color: var(--border);
   502→}
   503→.show-row.on .show-time { color: var(--green); }
   504→.show-time {
   505→  font-family: "Syne Mono", monospace;
   506→  font-size: 0.7rem;
   507→  color: var(--muted);
   508→  width: 68px;
   509→  flex-shrink: 0;
   510→  transition: color 0.25s;
   511→}
   512→.show-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
   513→.show-name {
   514→  font-family: "Syne", sans-serif;
   515→  font-weight: 700;
   516→  font-size: 0.92rem;
   517→  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
   518→  white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
   519→}
   520→.show-host { font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }
   521→.show-tag {
   522→  font-size: 0.62rem;
   523→  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
   524→  text-transform: uppercase;
   525→  padding: 4px 9px;
   526→  border-radius: 100px;
   527→  border: 1px solid rgba(46,204,64,0.2);
   528→  color: rgba(168,240,176,0.7);
   529→  flex-shrink: 0;
   530→}
   531→.show-feature {
   532→  background: var(--panel);
   533→  border: 1px solid var(--border);
   534→  border-radius: var(--r2);
   535→  padding: 28px;
   536→  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
   537→  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
   538→  gap: 16px;
   539→}
   540→.show-feature::before {
   541→  content: "";
   542→  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 120px;
   543→  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(46,204,64,0.06) 0%, transparent 100%);
   544→  pointer-events: none;
   545→}
   546→.show-wave { height: 60px; opacity: 0.5; }
   547→.show-wave svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
   548→.sf-title {
   549→  font-family: "Syne", sans-serif;
   550→  font-weight: 800;
   551→  font-size: 1.4rem;
   552→  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
   553→  line-height: 1.1;
   554→}
   555→.sf-body { font-size: 0.87rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.7; }
   556→.sf-cta {
   557→  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
   558→  color: var(--green);
   559→  font-size: 0.82rem;
   560→  font-weight: 600;
   561→  text-decoration: none;
   562→  cursor: pointer;
   563→  transition: gap 0.2s;
   564→}
   565→.sf-cta:hover { gap: 12px; }
   566→.show-propose {
   567→  padding-top: 16px;
   568→  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
   569→}
   570→.show-propose p { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 10px; }
   571→
   572→/* ── DIGITAL / AI ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
   573→#digital {
   574→  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg) 0%, var(--bg2) 100%);
   575→  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
   576→}
   577→#digital::before {
   578→  content: "";
   579→  position: absolute;
   580→  width: 500px; height: 500px;
   581→  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(46,204,64,0.07) 0%, transparent 70%);
   582→  bottom: -100px; right: -100px;
   583→  pointer-events: none;
   584→}
   585→.digital-grid {
   586→  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
   587→  gap: 48px;
   588→  margin-top: 48px;
   589→}
   590→.ai-cards { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
   591→.ai-card {
   592→  display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start;
   593→  background: var(--panel);
   594→  border: 1px solid var(--border);
   595→  border-radius: var(--r);
   596→  padding: 20px;
   597→  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
   598→  transition: border-color 0.3s;
   599→}
   600→.ai-card::before {
   601→  content: "";
   602→  position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 3px;
   603→  background: var(--green);
   604→  transform: scaleY(0);
   605→  transition: transform 0.3s;
   606→  transform-origin: bottom;
   607→}
   608→.ai-card:hover { border-color: rgba(46,204,64,0.3); }
   609→.ai-card:hover::before { transform: scaleY(1); }
   610→.ai-icon {
   611→  width: 42px; height: 42px; flex-shrink: 0;
   612→  background: rgba(46,204,64,0.08);
   613→  border: 1px solid rgba(46,204,64,0.2);
   614→  border-radius: 12px;
   615→  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
   616→  font-size: 1.1rem;
   617→}
   618→.ai-card-title {
   619→  font-family: "Syne", sans-serif;
   620→  font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.92rem;
   621→  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
   622→  margin-bottom: 5px;
   623→}
   624→.ai-card-body { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.6; }
   625→
   626→/* TERMINAL */
   627→.terminal {
   628→  background: #040d04;
   629→  border: 1px solid rgba(46,204,64,0.25);
   630→  border-radius: var(--r2);
   631→  overflow: hidden;
   632→  font-family: "Syne Mono", monospace;
   633→}
   634→.term-bar {
   635→  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
   636→  background: #081008;
   637→  padding: 12px 18px;
   638→  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
   639→}
   640→.td { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; }
   641→.td.r { background: #ff5f57; }
   642→.td.y { background: #febc2e; }
   643→.td.g { background: #28c840; }
   644→.term-title { font-size: 0.68rem; color: var(--muted); margin-left: 8px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
   645→.term-body { padding: 22px; font-size: 0.78rem; line-height: 2.1; }
   646→.tl { display: flex; gap: 10px; }
   647→.tp { color: var(--green); }
   648→.tc { color: var(--white); }
   649→.to { color: rgba(168,240,176,0.55); padding-left: 18px; }
   650→.tcur {
   651→  display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 13px;
   652→  background: var(--green); vertical-align: middle;
   653→  margin-left: 2px; animation: cblink 1s infinite;
   654→}
   655→@keyframes cblink { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0} }
   656→
   657→/* NOW LIVE CARD */
   658→.now-live-card {
   659→  background: var(--panel);
   660→  border: 1px solid var(--border);
   661→  border-radius: var(--r);
   662→  padding: 20px;
   663→  margin-top: 16px;
   664→}
   665→.now-live-card .eyebrow {
   666→  font-size: 0.68rem;
   667→  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
   668→  text-transform: uppercase;
   669→  color: var(--green);
   670→  margin-bottom: 6px;
   671→}
   672→.now-live-card h4 {
   673→  font-family: "Syne", sans-serif;
   674→  font-weight: 700;
   675→  font-size: 0.98rem;
   676→  margin-bottom: 4px;
   677→}
   678→.now-live-card p { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--muted); }
   679→
   680→/* ── COMMUNITY ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
   681→#community { background: var(--bg2); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
   682→.community-grid {
   683→  display: grid;
   684→  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
   685→  gap: 12px;
   686→  margin-top: 48px;
   687→}
   688→.com-card {
   689→  background: var(--panel);
   690→  border: 1px solid var(--border);
   691→  border-radius: var(--r2);
   692→  padding: 24px 20px;
   693→  transition: all 0.3s;
   694→  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
   695→}
   696→.com-card::after {
   697→  content: "";
   698→  position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 60px;
   699→  background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(46,204,64,0.06) 0%, transparent 100%);
   700→  opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s;
   701→}
   702→.com-card:hover { border-color: rgba(46,204,64,0.25); transform: translateY(-3px); }
   703→.com-card:hover::after { opacity: 1; }
   704→.com-emoji { font-size: 1.8rem; margin-bottom: 14px; display: block; }
   705→.com-title {
   706→  font-family: "Syne", sans-serif;
   707→  font-weight: 700;
   708→  font-size: 1rem;
   709→  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
   710→  margin-bottom: 10px;
   711→}
   712→.com-body { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.65; }
   713→
   714→/* ── FUNDERS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
   715→#funders { background: var(--bg); }
   716→.funder-box {
   717→  max-width: 740px; margin: 0 auto;
   718→  background: var(--panel);
   719→  border: 1px solid var(--border);
   720→  border-radius: var(--r3);
   721→  padding: clamp(36px, 8vw, 64px) clamp(24px, 6vw, 56px);
   722→  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
   723→  text-align: center;
   724→}
   725→.funder-box::before {
   726→  content: "";
   727→  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px;
   728→  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--green2), var(--green), var(--lime));
   729→}
   730→.funder-box::after {
   731→  content: "";
   732→  position: absolute;
   733→  width: 350px; height: 350px;
   734→  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(46,204,64,0.07) 0%, transparent 70%);
   735→  top: -80px; right: -80px;
   736→  pointer-events: none;
   737→}
   738→.funder-eye {
   739→  font-family: "Syne Mono", monospace;
   740→  font-size: 0.68rem;
   741→  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
   742→  text-transform: uppercase;
   743→  color: var(--green);
   744→  margin-bottom: 16px;
   745→}
   746→.funder-title {
   747→  font-family: "Syne", sans-serif;
   748→  font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4.5vw, 2.8rem);
   749→  font-weight: 800;
   750→  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
   751→  line-height: 1.1;
   752→  margin-bottom: 16px;
   753→}
   754→.funder-body {
   755→  font-size: clamp(0.87rem, 2vw, 0.97rem);
   756→  color: var(--muted);
   757→  line-height: 1.8;
   758→  max-width: 460px;
   759→  margin: 0 auto 32px;
   760→}
   761→.funder-btns { display: flex; gap: 12px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
   762→.funder-badges {
   763→  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
   764→  gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap;
   765→  margin-top: 40px;
   766→  padding-top: 32px;
   767→  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
   768→}
   769→.funder-badge {
   770→  font-family: "Syne", sans-serif;
   771→  font-size: 0.65rem;
   772→  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
   773→  text-transform: uppercase;
   774→  color: rgba(168,240,176,0.3);
   775→  font-weight: 700;
   776→}
   777→.funder-badge.hi { color: rgba(168,240,176,0.55); }
   778→.badge-sep { width: 1px; height: 16px; background: var(--border); }
   779→
   780→/* ── CONTACT ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
   781→#contact { background: var(--bg2); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
   782→.contact-grid {
   783→  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
   784→  gap: 48px;
   785→  margin-top: 0;
   786→}
   787→.contact-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; margin-top: 32px; }
   788→.ci {
   789→  display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start;
   790→}
   791→.ci-icon {
   792→  width: 38px; height: 38px; flex-shrink: 0;
   793→  background: rgba(46,204,64,0.08);
   794→  border: 1px solid rgba(46,204,64,0.2);
   795→  border-radius: 10px;
   796→  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
   797→  font-size: 0.95rem;
   798→}
   799→.ci-title { font-family: "Syne", sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.88rem; margin-bottom: 3px; }
   800→.ci-val { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--muted); }
   801→.contact-form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
   802→.fl { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; }
   803→.fl label {
   804→  font-size: 0.72rem;
   805→  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
   806→  text-transform: uppercase;
   807→  color: var(--muted);
   808→}
   809→.fi {
   810→  background: var(--panel);
   811→  border: 1px solid var(--border);
   812→  border-radius: 10px;
   813→  padding: 13px 16px;
   814→  color: var(--white);
   815→  font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif;
   816→  font-size: 0.92rem;
   817→  outline: none;
   818→  transition: border-color 0.2s;
   819→  width: 100%;
   820→  -webkit-appearance: none;
   821→}
   822→.fi:focus { border-color: rgba(46,204,64,0.4); }
   823→.fi::placeholder { color: rgba(168,240,176,0.2); }
   824→textarea.fi { resize: vertical; min-height: 110px; }
   825→
   826→/* WhatsApp CTA */
   827→.wa-cta {
   828→  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
   829→  background: rgba(37,211,102,0.08);
   830→  border: 1px solid rgba(37,211,102,0.2);
   831→  border-radius: var(--r);
   832→  padding: 16px 20px;
   833→  text-decoration: none;
   834→  transition: all 0.25s;
   835→  margin-top: 8px;
   836→}
   837→.wa-cta:hover { background: rgba(37,211,102,0.14); transform: translateY(-2px); }
   838→.wa-icon {
   839→  width: 40px; height: 40px; flex-shrink: 0;
   840→  background: #25d366;
   841→  border-radius: 50%;
   842→  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
   843→  font-size: 1.2rem;
   844→}
   845→.wa-text strong { display: block; font-family: "Syne", sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.92rem; }
   846→.wa-text span { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--muted); }
   847→
   848→/* ── FOOTER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
   849→footer {
   850→  background: var(--bg);
   851→  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
   852→  padding: 48px 20px 32px;
   853→}
   854→.footer-top {
   855→  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 40px;
   856→  margin-bottom: 40px;
   857→}
   858→.footer-brand p {
   859→  font-size: 0.84rem;
   860→  color: var(--muted);
   861→  line-height: 1.7;
   862→  margin-top: 14px;
   863→  max-width: 280px;
   864→}
   865→.socials { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 18px; }
   866→.social-a {
   867→  width: 36px; height: 36px;
   868→  background: var(--panel);
   869→  border: 1px solid var(--border);
   870→  border-radius: 50%;
   871→  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
   872→  font-size: 0.8rem;
   873→  text-decoration: none;
   874→  color: var(--muted);
   875→  transition: all 0.2s;
   876→}
   877→.social-a:hover { border-color: var(--green); color: var(--green); }
   878→.footer-cols { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 32px; }
   879→.footer-col h5 {
   880→  font-family: "Syne", sans-serif;
   881→  font-size: 0.72rem;
   882→  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
   883→  text-transform: uppercase;
   884→  color: var(--muted);
   885→  margin-bottom: 14px;
   886→  font-weight: 700;
   887→}
   888→.footer-col ul { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
   889→.footer-col ul li a {
   890→  font-size: 0.86rem;
   891→  color: rgba(168,240,176,0.45);
   892→  text-decoration: none;
   893→  transition: color 0.2s;
   894→}
   895→.footer-col ul li a:hover { color: var(--green); }
   896→.footer-bottom {
   897→  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
   898→  padding-top: 28px;
   899→  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
   900→  font-size: 0.76rem;
   901→  color: rgba(168,240,176,0.25);
   902→  text-align: center;
   903→}
   904→.footer-bottom a { color: var(--green); text-decoration: none; }
   905→
   906→/* ── REVEAL ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
   907→.rev { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); transition: opacity 0.65s ease, transform 0.65s ease; }
   908→.rev.in { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
   909→.rev.d1 { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
   910→.rev.d2 { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
   911→.rev.d3 { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
   912→
   913→/* ── RESPONSIVE — TABLET ────────────────────────────────────────── */
   914→@media (min-width: 640px) {
   915→  section { padding: 96px 36px; }
   916→  #hero { padding: 96px 36px 72px; }
   917→  .community-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
   918→  .contact-grid { flex-direction: row; gap: 64px; }
   919→  .contact-info-col { flex: 1; }
   920→  .contact-form-col { flex: 1; }
   921→  .footer-cols { flex-direction: row; gap: 40px; }
   922→  .footer-col { flex: 1; }
   923→  .footer-bottom { flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; text-align: left; }
   924→}
   925→
   926→/* ── RESPONSIVE — DESKTOP ───────────────────────────────────────── */
   927→@media (min-width: 900px) {
   928→  #nav { padding: 0 48px; }
   929→  section { padding: 112px 48px; }
   930→  #hero { padding: 120px 48px 88px; }
   931→  .nav-links { display: flex; }
   932→  .ham { display: none; }
   933→  .shows-wrap { flex-direction: row; align-items: flex-start; gap: 40px; }
   934→  .show-list { flex: 1; }
   935→  .show-feature { flex: 1; }
   936→  .digital-grid { flex-direction: row; gap: 64px; }
   937→  .digital-grid > div { flex: 1; }
   938→  .footer-top { flex-direction: row; gap: 60px; }
   939→  .footer-brand { flex: 1.5; }
   940→}
   941→
   942→@media (min-width: 1200px) {
   943→  section { padding: 120px 64px; }
   944→  #hero { padding: 128px 64px 96px; }
   945→  #nav { padding: 0 64px; }
   946→}
   947→
   948→</style>
   949→</head>
   950→<body>
   951→
   952→<!-- CURSORS -->
   953→<div id="cur" aria-hidden="true"></div>

   965→    <div class="live-dot"></div> Tune In Live

   972→    <img class="nav-logo-img" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Star FM 102.9 logo" width="40" height="40">
   973→    <div class="nav-wordmark">

   976→    </div>
   977→  </a>

   986→    <div class="lang-sw" role="group" aria-label="Language selector">

  1000→
  1001→<!-- HERO -->
  1002→<section id="hero">
  1003→  <div class="hero-glow" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  1004→  <div class="hero-wave" aria-hidden="true">
  1005→    <svg viewBox="0 0 1400 300" preserveAspectRatio="none">
  1006→      <polyline points="0,150 60,90 120,200 180,60 240,210 300,80 360,180 420,100 480,220 540,70 600,170 660,130 720,190 780,80 840,160 900,100 960,200 1020,120 1080,180 1140,90 1200,200 1260,130 1320,160 1380,140 1400,150" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  1007→    </svg>
  1008→  </div>
  1009→
  1010→  <div class="hero-badge">
  1011→    <div class="live-dot" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  1012→    <span data-i18n="hero_badge">24/7 Live — Klerksdorp &amp; North West Province</span>
  1013→  </div>
  1014→

  1213→<!-- COMMUNITY -->
  1214→<section id="community">
  1215→  <div class="sec-label rev" data-i18n="community_label">The Mission</div>
  1216→  <h2 class="sec-title rev" data-i18n="community_title">Built For The Community.</h2>
  1217→  <p class="sec-body rev" data-i18n="community_body">Star FM 102.9 is not a corporate station. We are owned by, built for, and powered by the community of Klerksdorp and the Southern District. Every broadcast is an act of empowerment.</p>
  1218→  <div class="community-grid" style="margin-top:48px;">
  1219→    <div class="com-card rev">
  1220→      <span class="com-emoji" aria-hidden="true">🏘️</span>
  1221→      <div class="com-title" data-i18n="com1_title">Hyperlocal Voices</div>
  1222→      <div class="com-body" data-i18n="com1_body">We platform local leaders, entrepreneurs, educators, and activists — giving a microphone to the people making real change.</div>
  1223→    </div>
  1224→    <div class="com-card rev d1">
  1225→      <span class="com-emoji" aria-hidden="true">📚</span>
  1226→      <div class="com-title" data-i18n="com2_title">Education First</div>
  1227→      <div class="com-body" data-i18n="com2_body">School information, adult literacy, bursary alerts, and skills training — education content runs every single day.</div>
  1228→    </div>
  1229→    <div class="com-card rev d2">
  1230→      <span class="com-emoji" aria-hidden="true">💼</span>
  1231→      <div class="com-title" data-i18n="com3_title">Economic Empowerment</div>
  1232→      <div class="com-body" data-i18n="com3_body">Tender opportunities, SMME resources, government grants and business tips that help listeners build real wealth.</div>
  1233→    </div>
  1234→    <div class="com-card rev d3">
  1235→      <span class="com-emoji" aria-hidden="true">🎵</span>
  1236→      <div class="com-title" data-i18n="com4_title">Culture &amp; Identity</div>
  1237→      <div class="com-body" data-i18n="com4_body">Local music, indigenous languages, cultural heritage and stories that remind our community who they are.</div>
  1238→    </div>
  1239→    <div class="com-card rev">
  1240→      <span class="com-emoji" aria-hidden="true">🤝</span>
  1241→      <div class="com-title" data-i18n="com5_title">Social Cohesion</div>
  1242→      <div class="com-body" data-i18n="com5_body">A place where all community members — regardless of background — come to listen, learn and belong.</div>
  1243→    </div>
  1244→    <div class="com-card rev d1">
  1245→      <span class="com-emoji" aria-hidden="true">🌍</span>

  1247→      <div class="com-body" data-i18n="com6_body">Modern, digital-first, and fundable — a community radio model worth scaling across South Africa.</div>
  1248→    </div>

  1399→<script>
  1400→// ── CURSOR (desktop only) ────────────────────────────────────────
  1401→if (window.matchMedia('(pointer: fine)').matches) {
  1402→  const cur = document.getElementById('cur');
  1403→  const curR = document.getElementById('cur-r');
  1404→  let mx=0,my=0,rx=0,ry=0;
  1405→  document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  1406→    mx = e.clientX; my = e.clientY;
  1407→    cur.style.left = mx+'px'; cur.style.top = my+'px';
  1408→  });
  1409→  (function loop(){ rx+=(mx-rx)*.1; ry+=(my-ry)*.1; curR.style.left=rx+'px'; curR.style.top=ry+'px'; requestAnimationFrame(loop); })();
  1410→}
  1411→
  1412→// ── NAV STUCK ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  1413→const nav = document.getElementById('nav');
  1414→window.addEventListener('scroll', () => nav.classList.toggle('stuck', window.scrollY > 50), {passive:true});
  1415→
  1416→// ── DRAWER ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  1417→const drawer = document.getElementById('drawer');
  1418→const ham = document.getElementById('ham');
  1419→function toggleD() {
  1420→  const open = drawer.classList.toggle('open');
  1421→  ham.classList.toggle('open', open);
  1422→  ham.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
  1423→  document.body.style.overflow = open ? 'hidden' : '';
  1424→}
  1425→function closeD() {
  1426→  drawer.classList.remove('open');
  1427→  ham.classList.remove('open');
  1428→  ham.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  1429→  document.body.style.overflow = '';
  1430→}
  1431→drawer.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target === drawer) closeD(); });
  1432→document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeD(); });
  1433→
  1434→// ── SCROLL REVEAL ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  1435→const revObs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
  1436→  entries.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('in'); revObs.unobserve(e.target); } });
  1437→}, { threshold: 0.08, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });
  1438→document.querySelectorAll('.rev').forEach(el => revObs.observe(el));
  1439→
  1440→// ── SHOW FEATURE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  1441→function featureShow(row, title, body) {
  1442→  document.querySelectorAll('.show-row').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('on'));
  1443→  row.classList.add('on');
  1444→  document.getElementById('sf-title').innerHTML = 'Now Featured:<br>' + title;
  1445→  document.getElementById('sf-body').textContent = body;
  1446→}
  1447→
  1448→// ── FORM SUBMIT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  1449→function submitForm(btn) {
  1450→  const orig = btn.textContent;
  1451→  btn.textContent = '✓ Message Sent!';
  1452→  btn.style.background = '#28c840';
  1453→  btn.disabled = true;
  1454→  setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = orig; btn.style.background = ''; btn.disabled = false; }, 3500);
  1455→}
  1456→
  1457→// ── COUNTER ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  1458→const fbEl = document.getElementById('cnt-fb');
  1459→new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => {
  1460→  if (!e.isIntersecting) return;
  1461→  let n = 0; const t = 11000;
  1462→  const step = t / (1800/16);
  1463→  const id = setInterval(() => {
  1464→    n = Math.min(n + step, t);
  1465→    fbEl.textContent = (n >= t ? '11,000' : Math.floor(n).toLocaleString()) + '+';
  1466→    if (n >= t) clearInterval(id);
  1467→  }, 16);
  1468→}, {threshold:0.5}).observe(fbEl);

  1699→let lang = 'en';
  1700→function setLang(l) {
  1701→  lang = l;
  1702→  const t = T[l];
  1703→  document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => {
  1704→    const k = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
  1705→    if (t[k] !== undefined) el.innerHTML = t[k];
  1706→  });
  1707→  document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-ph]').forEach(el => {
  1708→    const k = el.getAttribute('data-i18n-ph');
  1709→    if (t[k] !== undefined) el.placeholder = t[k];
  1710→  });
  1711→  document.querySelectorAll('.lang-sw button').forEach(btn => {
  1712→    const pressed = btn.getAttribute('onclick') === `setLang('${l}')`;
  1713→    btn.classList.toggle('on', pressed);
  1714→    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', pressed);
  1715→  });
  1716→  document.documentElement.lang = l === 'tn' ? 'tn' : l === 'st' ? 'st' : 'en';
  1717→}
  1718→</script>
